headline: Week 14: The Hot Cocks Drop a 190-Burger and Nobody's Safe
subhead: Six teams won, six teams got buried, and Jets' Juniors bricked a 117 like it was Week 1 again.
matchOfTheWeek: Olave Garden vs LargestofRocks was the only game with a pulse, decided by 5.36 points after Puka Nacua dumped 41.80 on Patrickreegs's behalf. The kicker? LargestofRocks left 28.86 points on the bench — Drew Lock and Quentin Johnston combined for 31+ in street clothes while the active lineup waved goodbye to a winnable game. That's not losing. That's losing with footnotes.
mainRecap:
Hot Cocks dropped 190.42 and turned T swift's Baddies into a charity stream. Ja'Marr Chase went full nuclear with 45.10, Tyreek chipped in 28.10, and Tnicolle got to spend the afternoon watching her team get curb-stomped by 50. That's not a matchup, that's a hostage situation.

The Good Ladds rode Josh Allen's 51.88-point Voltron impression to a 173-point thrashing of Stroud Boys. Bjewett, your team is named after a quarterback and you got out-QB'd by 30. Isaac Guerendo posted 26.80 like he's been doing this for years. Mig is cooking.

Put an AR to My Head hung 164 on Jets' Juniors and Jordan Addison went off for 39.30 — and somehow Kyle STILL left 21.90 points of Jalen McMillan on the bench. You won by 46, dude, but optimal-you was running up the score like a JV coach with daddy issues. Meanwhile Wunder's squad scored 117.60, the literal lowest in the league, in a week where Sam Darnold dropped 34. Read that again.

226 Alpha handled MassiveCocks by 35 despite Szara benching a 20.80 Stafford performance — which is impressive efficiency for a guy who left a top-3 QB week chilling. 7BigPapi7, you put up 130 in a SuperFlex league. That's a punt.

Bo Nix Celli quietly ran the most efficient lineup of the week (98.7%) and Zach Charbonnet went 38.30 to bury OnlyFants. Cubby got 32 from JJ and still lost — when Jefferson can't save you, nothing can.

And Olave Garden squeaked by while leaving Juwan Johnson's 17 on the pine. A win's a win, Reegs, but stop benching touchdowns at a TE-premium position.

powerRankings.blurb: 190 points, Chase and Tyreek both eating, and the rest of the league filing restraining orders.
Josh Allen put up 51 and Mig is starting to look like the guy nobody wants to draw in Round 1.
Won by 35 with a starting QB on the bench going for 20 — terrifying depth, questionable decision-making.
